title: Salamander Deluxe Pack Plus
native_title: 沙羅曼蛇 ＤＥＬＵＸＥ ＰＡＣＫ ＰＬＵＳ
overview:
All Three "Salamander" Games Arrive at Once!!

The "Salamander" series gathers here! There is an excitement you can only taste by playing all three masterpieces!!

This disc collects three arcade space shooters. Alone or with a friend at the same time, pilot the Vic Viper and its partner ship against alien hordes, collecting power-ups for missiles, lasers and trailing multiples that copy your fire.

- Salamander: defend the water planet Latis from the Bacterian invaders across stages that switch between horizontal and vertical scrolling
- Life Force: fly into an enormous living organism that devours everything in its path, using the Gradius-style power meter
- Salamander 2: fight the subspace life form Tomb, and launch your options as homing lightning strikes
- Two players can play simultaneously in all three games

『沙羅曼蛇』全3作、一挙登場!!

『沙羅曼蛇』シリーズがここに集結!
3つの名作をプレイして初めて味わえる興奮がある!!
